title: Homily II — The new Solomon brings the ark home

edition.locus: Migne, PG 96 (Paris, 1860), Homily II on the Dormition, cols. 737-740 (PDF leaves 410-411)

source_text: Τότε δὴ, τότε ἡ κιβωτὸς τοῦ Κυρίου ἀπάρασα ἐξ ὄρους Σιὼν τοῖς τῶν ἀποστόλων κλεινοῖς ὤμοις ἐποχουμένη πρὸς τὸ οὐράνιον τέμενος διὰ μέσου τοῦ τάφου διαβιβάζεται. Καὶ πρότερον μὲν διὰ μέσου τοῦ ἄστεος ἄγεται, οἷά τις νύμφη περικαλλὴς τῇ ἀπροσίτῳ αἴγλῃ ὡραϊζομένη τοῦ Πνεύματος, καὶ οὕτως εἰς τὸ ἱερώτατον τῆς Γεθσημανῆ χωρίον κομίζεται, ἀγγέλων προτρεχόντων, παρεπομένων, συγκαλυπτόντων ταῖς πτέρυξι, καὶ παντὸς τοῦ τῆς Ἐκκλησίας πληρώματος. Καὶ ὥσπερ ὁ βασιλεὺς Σολομὼν ἐπὶ τῇ καταπαύσει τῆς κιβωτοῦ ἐν ναῷ Κυρίου, ὃν αὐτὸς ἐδείματο, πάντας τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους Ἰσραὴλ ἐν Σιὼν ἠκκλησίασε, τοῦ ἀνενεγκεῖν τὴν κιβωτὸν διαθήκης Κυρίου ἐκ πόλεως Δαβίδ· αὕτη ἐστὶν Σιών· καὶ ἦραν οἱ ἱερεῖς τὴν κιβωτὸν καὶ τὴν σκηνὴν τοῦ μαρτυρίου, καὶ ἀνεβίβασαν αὐτὰ οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευῖται· καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς, καὶ ὁ λαὸς ἅπας ἔμπροσθεν τῆς κιβωτοῦ θύοντες βόας καὶ πρόβατα ἀναρίθμητα· καὶ εἰσφέρουσιν οἱ ἱερεῖς τὴν κιβωτὸν διαθήκης Κυρίου εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτῆς εἰς τὸ δαβὶρ τοῦ οἴκου, εἰς τὰ Ἅγια τῶν ἁγίων, ὑπὸ τὰς πτέρυγας τῶν Χερουβίμ· οὕτω δὴ καὶ νῦν ἐπὶ τῇ καταπαύσει τῆς νοερᾶς κιβωτοῦ, οὐ διαθήκης Κυρίου, ἀλλ' αὐτῆς τῆς τοῦ Θεοῦ Λόγου ὑποστάσεως, αὐτὸς ὁ νέος Σολομὼν, ὁ εἰρηνάρχης, καὶ τοῦ παντὸς ἀριστοτέχνης τῶν οὐρανίων νόων τὰ ὑπερκόσμια τάγματα, καὶ τῆς Νέας Διαθήκης τοὺς προὔχοντας, τοὺς ἀποστόλους φημὶ, σὺν παντὶ τῷ ἐν Ἱερουσαλὴμ τῶν ἁγίων λαῷ σήμερον ἠκκλησίασε, καὶ τὴν μὲν ψυχὴν δι' ἀγγέλων εἰς τὰ Ἅγια τῶν ἁγίων, τὰ ἀρχέτυπα τὰ ἀληθινὰ καὶ οὐράνια εἰσοικίζεται, ἐπ' αὐτὰς τῶν τετραμόρφων ζώων τὰς πτέρυγας, καὶ τῷ ἑαυτοῦ παρεστήσατο θρόνῳ, εἰς τὸ ἐνδότερον τοῦ καταπετάσματος, ὅπου πρόδρομος αὐτὸς Χριστὸς σωματικῶς εἰσελήλυθε· τὸ δὲ σῶμα ταῖς τῶν ἀποστόλων χερσὶ προκομίζεται, τοῦ Βασιλέως τῶν βασιλευόντων συγκαλύπτοντος τῇ αἴγλῃ τῆς ἀοράτου θεότητος, καὶ παντὸς τοῦ τῶν ἁγίων συστήματος προτρεχόντων, καὶ ἱερὰς ἀφιέντων βοὰς, καὶ θυόντων θυσίαν αἰνέσεως, ἕως ὡς παστάδι τῷ τάφῳ, καὶ δι' αὐτοῦ τῇ τῆς Ἐδὲμ τρυφῇ, καὶ οὐρανίοις ἐναπετέθη σκηνώμασι.
pass_a_gloss: Then indeed, then the ark (κιβωτός) of the Lord (Κύριος), having set out (ἀπαίρω) from Mount (ὄρος) Zion (Σιών), carried (ἐποχέομαι) on the famous (κλεινοί) shoulders (ὦμοι) of the apostles, is conveyed across (διαβιβάζω) to the heavenly precinct (τέμενος) through the midst of the tomb (τάφος). And first through the midst of the town (ἄστυ) she is led (ἄγω), like some very beautiful bride (νύμφη) adorned (ὡραΐζω) with the unapproachable (ἀπρόσιτος) radiance (αἴγλη) of the Spirit, and thus to the most holy place (χωρίον) of Gethsemane (Γεθσημανῆ) she is brought (κομίζω), angels running before, following, covering together with wings (πτέρυγες), and all the fullness (πλήρωμα) of the Church (Ἐκκλησία). And as King Solomon (Σολομών) at the resting of the ark in the temple (ναός) of the Lord, which he himself built (δέμω), assembled all the elders of Israel in Zion to bring up (ἀναφέρω) the ark of the covenant (διαθήκη) of the Lord from the city (πόλις) of David: this is Zion; and the priests (ἱερεῖς) took up (αἴρω) the ark and the tent (σκηνή) of witness (μαρτύριον), and the priests and the Levites (Λευῖται) brought them up (ἀναβιβάζω); and the king and all the people (λαός) before the ark sacrificing (θύω) oxen (βόες) and sheep (πρόβατα) innumerable; and the priests bring in (εἰσφέρω) the ark of the covenant of the Lord into its place, into the dabir of the house (οἶκος), into the Holy of holies, under the wings of the Cherubim (Χερουβίμ); so indeed now at the resting of the intellectual/spiritual (νοερά) ark, not of the covenant of the Lord but of the very hypostasis (ὑπόστασις) of God the Word, the new Solomon himself, the peace-ruler, and best-craftsman of the all, the supercosmic orders (τάγματα) of the heavenly minds (νόες), and the foremost of the New Covenant, I mean the apostles, with all the people of the saints (ἅγιοι) in Jerusalem, today (σήμερον) assembled; and the soul through angels into the Holy of holies, the true (ἀληθινά) and heavenly archetypes (ἀρχέτυπα), he settles (εἰσοικίζω), upon the very wings of the four-formed living creatures (ζῷα), and presented (παρίστημι) [it] to his own throne, into the inner [part] of the veil, where as forerunner (πρόδρομος) Christ himself bodily (σωματικῶς) has entered (εἰσέρχομαι); and the body is carried forward (προκομίζω) by the hands of the apostles, the King of those reigning covering [it] with the radiance of the invisible (ἀόρατος) Godhead (θεότης), and all the company (σύστημα) of the saints running before, and sending forth (ἀφίημι) holy shouts, and sacrificing a sacrifice of praise, until as in a bridal chamber (παστάς), in the tomb, and through it in the delight (τρυφή) of Eden (Ἐδέμ), and in heavenly tabernacles (σκηνώματα), it was laid away.
pass_b_english: Then, yes, then the ark of the Lord, setting out from Mount Zion and borne on the glorious shoulders of the apostles, is carried by way of the tomb to the heavenly sanctuary. First she is led through the middle of the city, like a bride of great beauty adorned with the unapproachable radiance of the Spirit, and so she is brought to the most holy place of Gethsemane, with angels running before her, following after her and covering her with their wings, and with the whole body of the Church.

King Solomon, at the laying to rest of the ark in the temple of the Lord which he himself had built, assembled all the elders of Israel in Zion, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the city of David, which is Zion; and the priests took up the ark and the tent of witness, and the priests and the Levites brought them up; and the king and all the people were before the ark, sacrificing oxen and sheep beyond number; and the priests bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord into its place, into the inner sanctuary of the house, into the Holy of Holies, under the wings of the cherubim (1 Kings 8:1-6; 2 Chronicles 5:2-7).

Just as he did, so now too, at the laying to rest of the spiritual ark, the ark not of the covenant of the Lord but of the very hypostasis of God the Word, the new Solomon himself, the ruler of peace and master craftsman of the universe, has today assembled the ranks of the heavenly minds that are above the world, and the leaders of the New Covenant, I mean the apostles, with all the people of the saints in Jerusalem. Her soul he brings through angels to dwell in the Holy of Holies, the true and heavenly archetypes (Hebrews 9:24), upon the very wings of the four-faced living creatures (Ezekiel 1:5-10), and he has set it beside his own throne, within the veil, where Christ himself has entered bodily as forerunner (Hebrews 6:19-20). Her body is carried forward in the hands of the apostles, while the King of kings (1 Timothy 6:15) covers it with the radiance of his invisible Godhead, and the whole company of the saints runs ahead, sending up holy cries and offering a sacrifice of praise, until it was laid in the tomb as in a bridal chamber, and through the tomb in the delight of Eden and in the heavenly dwellings.

choices.note: The printed margin gives III Reg. 8:1ff and II Paral. 5:2ff;
III Reg.
(3 Kingdoms LXX) is 1 Kings in English Bibles.

The Solomon passage follows the LXX of 1 Kings 8:1-6 closely, including "this is Zion", "the tent of witness" and δαβίρ (the Hebrew devir, the innermost room of the temple), rendered "the inner sanctuary".
The quoted narrative keeps its shift to the present ("the priests bring").
The long Greek comparison ("as Solomon ... so now the new Solomon") is split into two paragraphs;
"Just as he did" picks up the ὥσπερ ...
οὕτω frame and adds no content.
ἠκκλησίασε ("assembled", literally "called into assembly") plays on Ἐκκλησία, which English cannot keep.
νοερὰ κιβωτός rendered "spiritual ark" (literally "ark endowed with mind").
ὑπόστασις kept as "hypostasis", as in Homily I.

εἰρηνάρχης ("ruler of peace", playing on Solomon's name) rendered "the ruler of peace"; review replaced "Prince of Peace", which would point the reader to Isaiah 9:6, a verse the Greek does not quote.
τὰ ἀρχέτυπα τὰ ἀληθινά answers Hebrews 9:24 (the holy places made with hands are copies of the true ones;
Christ entered heaven itself); cited.
τετράμορφα ζῷα are the four-faced living creatures of Ezekiel 1:5-10; cited.
"Within the veil, where Christ has entered as forerunner" is Hebrews 6:19-20; cited.
ὁ Βασιλεὺς τῶν βασιλευόντων is the wording of 1 Timothy 6:15; rendered "the King of kings".
θυσία αἰνέσεως ("sacrifice of praise") is a stock biblical phrase (Leviticus 7:12;
Psalm 50:14, LXX 49:14;
Hebrews 13:15) with no single target; left uncited.
"The delight of Eden" echoes the LXX "paradise of delight" (Genesis 2:15; 3:23); left uncited.
The ark carried on shoulders may recall 1 Chronicles 15:15; uncertain, uncited.
πλήρωμα τῆς Ἐκκλησίας rendered "the whole body of the Church".
The overflow clause ὡς παστάδι τῷ τάφῳ ... was read from the page image (see source notes).
The final verb ἐναπετέθη is aorist after a run of presents; kept as past ("was laid").
Edition variants: (47) νῦν: Colb.
τότε ("then");
(48) βοάς: R.
φωνάς ("voices"); neither changes the sense materially.
Review checked the overflow line ὡς παστάδι τῷ τάφῳ ...
σκηνώμασι on the page image (leaf 411, across cols. 739-740).
